ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A centralized high-intensity white 'V' or anchor-shaped patch extends from the peduncle transition into the mid-lobes. The left lobe contains heavy black mottling and stippling within the white region. The right lobe features a relatively cleaner horizontal white band. Both lobes are bordered by thick, continuous black pigmentation along the leading and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp, symmetric V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a narrow pixel-width at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serration along the inner-to-mid trailing edge. High-frequency, irregular pixel protrusions (10-20 pixels in height) are localized at the extreme distal tips, corresponding to biological encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a smooth concave curve from the median notch toward the tips, ending in a slight posterior flare at the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast brown and white pixel clusters (biological encrustations) are concentrated on both distal tips. Scattered circular white micro-spots are detected against the dark pigmentation of the lower central region and left lobe edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark vertical linear disruptions are visible on the right white patch. A single, prominent vertical stroke is located approximately two-thirds of the way to the right tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustations (likely barnacles) present on the distal tips of both fluke lobes, creating irregular, jagged topography.
other_distinctive_markers: The central white pigmentation forms a distinct symmetrical 'winged' anchor shape, characterized by high-contrast transition boundaries between the white inner region and black outer margin.
